Oneliner

Educational and amateur radio mission linear transponder.
Description
  • Goal of enthusing and educating young people about radio, space, physics and electronics. 435 to 145 MHz Linear Transponder for SSB/CW operation.
  • Carries a materials science experiment, from which the school students can receive telemetry data and which they can compare to the results they obtained from similar reference experiments in the classroom.
  • This experiment resembles the Leslie's Cube experiment.
